findings.title: Dry runs can write through preserved symlinks
findings.description: The sandbox preserves symlinks, then runs the installer against them. For example, an absolute `.claude/rules` symlink still points to the real directory; `InstallManifest.installFile()` writes through it during `--dry-run`. Changes under that symlink are also omitted from the report because `regularFilesUnder()` ignores symlinks. Materialize isolated copies or reject unsafe links, and add a regression test proving external files remain unchanged.

findings.title: Native worktree pruning drops path-containment protection
findings.description: The replacement worktree installer invokes `InstallManifest.finish()`, which joins manifest paths to the root and deletes checksum-matching files without checking containment (`packages/cli/src/ideInstall/manifest.ts:187-193`). A manifest entry containing `../outside-file` can therefore delete a file outside the checkout; symlinked parent directories also escape containment. The removed `pruneStaleFiles()` explicitly guarded both cases. Restore those protections in the native manifest pruner and retain equivalent regression tests.
